name: chest-logos
_about: Left-chest T-shirt logos: absurd animal occupations in a riso style (gpt-image-2.5 gave the best results in testing). Then: falg cutout <file> --fit 8.5 8.5 --min-line-mm 0.5 -o prints/
template: {subject}: chest-up portrait bust. Dignified, deadpan and quietly funny.

subject.sloth-firefighter: A sloth firefighter wearing a big firefighter helmet and a heavy fire coat, holding a tiny coiled hose, eyes half-closed, utterly unhurried
subject.goose-security: A goose security guard wearing a peaked security cap, dark sunglasses and a jacket with a badge, neck held stiffly upright, very serious
subject.walrus-lifeguard: A walrus lifeguard with a whistle on a cord, a lifeguard tank top and a sun visor, big tusks and moustache, calmly on duty
subject.raccoon-chef: A raccoon sushi chef wearing a white headband and a chef's jacket, proudly holding up one piece of sushi
subject.pelican-postman: A pelican postman wearing a postman's cap and a uniform jacket, a letter sticking out of its big beak pouch

style.riso: Retro risograph print with 3 spot colours (fluorescent orange, teal, warm brown). All shading made of visible coarse halftone dots and grain, slight misregistration between colour layers, plenty of white space inside the figures.

lineart.text: Bold, clean hand-drawn ink line art with confident outlines and simple interior lines. Lots of open space, simple charm. Not a sticker: no die-cut outline, no white border around the figures.

set.colour: One ink only: everything drawn in a single hot neon pink colour (#FF2D95) on white.

vars.composition: A small left-chest logo design. Square image; the design has a compact, roughly square or slightly tall silhouette, centered, filling about 90% of the image height with a thin margin.
vars.background: Isolated on a plain flat pure white background (#FFFFFF) filling the whole image. White areas of the image will be left unprinted.
vars.fill: It will be printed small, about 8.5 cm wide, so keep it bold and simple: thick confident strokes, chunky shapes, solid areas are fine. No hairlines, no fine hatching, no tiny dots, no small details that would disappear at small size.
common: Flat digital print artwork, viewed straight on: just the design itself, NOT a photo or mockup of a garment, no fabric, no product shot.
No text, no lettering, no signature, no ground shadow. No soft gradients, no airbrush, no glow, no semi-transparent washes. No frame, no border.
vars.colour: Hot neon pink (#FF2D95) is the dominant colour, with at most one or two small accent colours.
